en: Ardense Jagers" in many places (Martelange, Bodange, Strainchamps, Chabrehez) causing important delays. The Germans were so surprised that they lost so much time because of these small units that destroyed all documents so their superiors couldn’t find out what happened. Both Guderain and Rommel would later praise the effective destructions and delaying tactics the Belgian army performed and would call them the "Grey Wolves".
zh: Ardense Jagers”小股部队的顽强抵抗，造成了严重延误。德军十分惊讶，因为这些小部队销毁了所有文件，使他们的上级无法查明发生了什么，从而耽误了如此多的时间。古德里安和隆美尔后来都称赞比利时军队实施的破坏和迟滞战术十分有效，并称他们为“灰狼”。

en: Ardense Jagers" in their delaying tactics and demolition works. Once completed, you must retreat northwards to the Maas River and join the main body of the Belgian army at the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position). As you know, this an elite motorized division of the regular army that thanks to its greater mobility can help other units where needed, notably performing reconnaissance and providing protection. We are confident you will honour your tasks.

en: The expected German attack has started. Early in the morning the Germans have crossed the Dutch border and in few hours they will arrive at our delaying line ("Position de Couverture") situated behind the Canal Albert and the Maas river from Antwerp to Arlon. With the support of the strong fortress of Eben-Emael, you must contain the Germans in the "Position de couverture" for as long as possible in order to allow our troops, as well as that of our French and British allies, to occupy their positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position for our allies), the main defence line where is foreseen to fight the decisive battle.
zh: 预料中的德军进攻已经开始。清晨德军越过了荷兰边境，几小时内他们就会抵达我们位于阿尔贝运河与马斯河之后、从安特卫普到阿尔隆的迟滞线（“Position de Couverture”）。在坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞支援下，你必须在“Position de couverture”尽可能久地遏制德军，以便我军以及法国和英国盟军的部队进入“Ligne KW”（我们的盟友称之为戴尔河阵地）的阵地，那是预计将进行决定性会战的主要防线。

en: The motorisation of the Cavalry Corps ("Corps de Cavalerie") decided in 1935 is now almost completed. This mobile force will complement our main fortified positions and defence lines providing support where needed.
zh: 1935年决定的骑兵军（“Corps de Cavalerie”）摩托化如今已接近完成。这支机动部队将配合我们的主要筑垒阵地和防线，在需要之处提供支援。

en: This year the manoeuvres of the Belgian army aim to prove that the motorisation of the "Corps de Cavalerie" is value for money. As Commander of the Regiment "2e Lanciers" of the 1st Cavalry Division ("1ère Division de Cavalerie") you must contribute to demonstrate its high mobility by making a spectacular move and quickly take the VH.
zh: 今年比利时军队的演习旨在证明“Corps de Cavalerie”的摩托化是物有所值的。作为第1骑兵师（“1ère Division de Cavalerie”）第2枪骑兵团（“2e Lanciers”）的指挥官，你必须通过一次引人注目的机动来展示其高度机动性，并迅速夺取胜利格。

en: A glorious victory, Herr Feldmarschall!  The Bolsheviks have surrendered unconditionally!  We will require the independence of Bylorussia and the Ukraine under German protection, which will stabilize our Eastern borders.  We are about to sign a peace treaty with the English and Americans which will involve our withdrawal from England and France (we keep Alsace-Lorraine).  Now we will have the peace necessary to develop the Fatherland to its full potential.
zh: 光荣的胜利，元帅阁下！布尔什维克已无条件投降！我们将要求白俄罗斯和乌克兰在德国保护下独立，这将稳定我们的东部边界。我们即将与英国人和美国人签署和约，内容包括我们从英格兰和法国撤军（我们保留阿尔萨斯-洛林）。现在我们将获得必要的和平，来充分开发祖国的全部潜力。

We must warn you that we expect massive Russian counterattacks in your sector to begin within ten days. If you are unable to take all of your objectives, you must at a minimum hold two objectives.
zh: 堡垒行动的时刻已经到来。你要进攻并歼灭库尔斯克突出部的苏军。夺取前线后方的若干重要城市（包括库尔斯克），是此战的关键。你必须在7月24日前夺取所有目标。必须提醒你，我们预计你所在战区将在十天内遭到苏军的大规模反攻。如果你无法夺取全部目标，至少必须守住两个目标。
